hypothesis: Training on a larger corpus (619 examples) with greedy decoding should push quality further above the ~0.32 in-context plateau, since more data gives the adapter better generalisation and greedy eliminates sampling noise that was masking real gains.
technique: A single greedy on-device call using a LoRA adapter (v2a, epoch 2) fine-tuned on 558 train pairs (corpus 312→619, lr 5e-4, early-stopped at epoch 2 before overfitting). Deterministic greedy decoding is used throughout, locking the methodology established in this experiment.
result: Scored 0.368 on full-30 greedy (1 win / 2 ties / 26 losses vs Sonnet); rubric atom=4, spec=3, cover=3, nat=4, nonRed=4. Weaker than its sibling epoch 1 (0.409, the new best) and below the v2a_e1 bar on most dimensions — discarded. Confirms that epoch 2 overfit, validating the early-stop decision.
